# Base Profile: ready.pack

## Always Load

- `bthwani-unified-experience-review`
- `bthwani-ready-pack`

## Use When

- a closure bundle must be prepared
- a ready folder must be updated honestly
- phase-scoped readiness must be packaged for later consumption

## Primary Contract

- determine what is truly closed
- package only phase-correct readiness
- label what is not ready
- preserve traceability
- avoid fake completion claims

## Typical Overlays

- `overlay.violation-audit` when blockers or adoption blockers must be listed explicitly
- `overlay.design-review` only when visual direction quality must be summarized as part of closure
- `overlay.ux-flow-review` only when journey or click-budget evidence must be summarized as part of closure
